weak_findings.reason: Attack path partially does not follow as written: it claims the HTML-encoded `website` value is placed in a URL/link context and executes there. In app/views/profile.html the only href sink (line 78, `<a href="{{firstNameSafeString}}">`) uses firstNameSafeString, not website; the `website` variable appears only in an input value attribute (line 70). The wrong-context-encoding class is real (app/routes/profile.js:28 uses encodeForHTML, with the code's own @FIXME confirming URL-context encoding is needed, and swig autoescape is off), so the finding is grounded, but the specific source-to-sink path described is imprecise/conflated.

notes: Reference-free quality judgment of /tmp/rel_runs/nodegoat/run1 against the real repo at /tmp/eval_targets/nodegoat. Sampled 13 findings spanning CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM and verified each against source. 12/13 sound: TM-001 eval RCE (app/routes/contributions.js:32-34), TM-002 cleartext passwords (app/data/user-dao.js:25,61), TM-003 unencrypted PII (app/data/profile-dao.js:42-76), TM-004 $where NoSQL injection (app/data/allocations-dao.js:78), TM-005 committed RSA key (artifacts/cert/server.key), TM-007 seed admin/Admin_123 isAdmin:true (artifacts/db-reset.js:12-21; docker-compose runs db-reset on startup with empty NODE_ENV=development), TM-008 IDOR userId from req.params (app/routes/allocations.js:18), TM-009 /benefits guarded only by isLoggedIn (app/routes/index.js:55-60, app/routes/benefits.js), TM-010 SSRF needle.get(req.query.url+symbol) (app/routes/research.js:15-16), TM-011 open redirect res.redirect(req.query.url) (app/routes/index.js:72), TM-014 http.createServer/https commented (server.js:145-155), TM-019 ReDoS /([0-9]+)+\\#/ (app/routes/profile.js:59). Severities are defensible: L/I reasoning is coherent and the OWASP risk bands are applied consistently (the report even logs a self-correction re-banding 20-point findings to CRITICAL). Only TM-013 rated weak (attack-path source/sink conflation, see weak_findings). Proportionality is proportionate: every one of the 25 findings traces to a specific live sink or commented-out control in the real code (verified config secrets in config/env/all.js + ZAP key in config/env/development.js, marked 0.3.5/mongodb ^2.1.18/needle 2.2.4/swig ^1.4.2 in package.json, Dockerfile:15 commented hardening, error.js raw-error render); no invented components, no speculative padding, and 3 surfaces are explicitly routed to no_issue_surface. Minor non-finding metadata slip: report tech table lists consolidate at ^1.4.2 but package.json pins consolidate ^0.14.1 (swig is ^1.4.2). TM-012 leans slightly optimistic on likelihood given marked.setOptions({sanitize:true}) in server.js (a known-bypassable 0.3.5 sanitizer), but the report acknowledges this and the finding remains sound.
